concept.literalSynthesis: A compact surveyor's pick with a straight, bright shard shot and a returning crescent shard. The packet's two parent records are empty synthetic placeholders, so no concrete parent appearance or identity is available to reproduce.
concept.coreMechanic: A reusable pick mines on primary use while launching one straight shard; alternate use throws a separate shard that returns after its outbound interval. Holding the tool refreshes a named utility effect that highlights eligible treasure and restores a modest amount of life over time. The two shots are separate input roots, so neither active input launches the other's projectile. These are newly authored mechanics for the synthetic brief, not observations about the empty parent records. A 0.4-second base use interval and modest projectile damage keep the repeated attacks bounded; pick power is positive and native mining is attached to the primary spawn action. The held utility is useful sustained exploration support, not a limited burst.

concept.playerExperience: Primary mines and fires straight; alternate throws the returning shot; holding the selected tool refreshes treasure highlighting and 1 HP/s regeneration. The two attacks remain isolated. The tool is reusable, and its sustained held utility has no authored recurring resource payment.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Mine with the pick and fire one straight damaging shard.
Throw one damaging shard that returns after its outbound interval.
While the tool remains selected and held, refresh ore highlighting and modest life regeneration.

realization.description: Primary use swings the pick and launches one straight shard; its projectile does not mine. Alternate use launches a separate shard that turns back toward you after 0.8 seconds, or begins returning sooner if it hits a wall. Each shard has a 1.2- or 2.4-second lifetime respectively and can damage once. While this tool is selected and held, it refreshes an effect that highlights eligible treasure and restores 1 HP per second; the effect lingers for up to 1.5 seconds after release. Pick power is 100%. The item is reusable.
realization.playerExperience: The straight shot gives primary use reach while preserving native pick mining; the alternate return shot gives a distinct throw. Holding the tool supplies steady exploration utility without a recurring resource cost.
